info.name: Monnify Disbursements API
info.description:
Initiate single and bulk NIP transfers to Nigerian bank accounts. As of April 2026 the disbursement flow requires Name Inquiry first then a Disbursement Request that carries the verified beneficiary account name. A sender-information object has been supported on initiation since October 2025. Two-factor authorization with OTP applies to single transfers.


Contact Support:
 Name: Monnify Developer Support
